'''icebreath Broken Musicians Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 15 September 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 MKOS icebreath DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3), Rodian (V) (Virtual Set 3), Jabba's Influence (V) (Virtual Set 6), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

The most broken version of musicians I have ever seen!

== Notes ==

* Original-era (V): Rodian (V) (VS3); Greedo (V) (VS4); Jabba's Influence (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (VS6).
* Posted 'Omni Box combo' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Defensive Fire' (no combo mark) dested the plain Defensive Fire.
* Unique cards posted x2 (Nizuc Bek, Ak-rev, Rystall, Lyn Me, Scum And Villainy) and Tech Mo'r x3 dested as posted.
* Original-era printing corrected: Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

What, were you expecting LIGHT SIDE musicians?  >;)

When properly played, this deck can give you a one-shot beatdown of 100+ power, power reduction on your opponent's side of around 20(ish), and up to two characters removed from your opponent's side of the battle (one a la Nizuc Bek, and a possible shot with Nevar Yalnal).

Here's the skinny... between S&V; and Greeata reducing your musicians' deploy cost, and Lyn Me making Fett and Greedo drop for free at the same site, AND the fact that everyone's pullable, you can drop a full-fledged beatdown squad for about 5-6 Force.  You'll have a good shot at stacking your destinies for battle with Tech Mo'r and Omni Box, so you should have no excuse NOT to be able to maximize the beat potential.

Fairly straightforward strategy, really.  Drop, beat, use Elis if need be for a second beat, etc.  I'm not going to go in depth on what the musicians do... you guys should know where the cardlists are! (hint: http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html)

A few card choices:

Defensive Fire - good annoyance card, and also has the possibility of dropping a Houjix from their hand.

Limited Resources - just in case you need something to finish them off.  >;)

Nevar Yalnal - as stated above, for additional character removal if needed.  If not... it's a destiny 6 floating in the deck.

Just my little protest deck for the current anti Uh-Oh (V) discussion.  This can be just as devestating, and has just as many ways around it.

Enjoy!

David "Icebreath" Kangas
